impact: The same admitted causal trace family can receive different split labels depending on which current dataset path is used.

This does not by itself leak a family inside either individual splitter, but it prevents a single frozen dataset-split authority and can invalidate cross-stage dataset receipts/evaluation comparability.

The owner one-shot training directive requires leak-resistant split-by-causal-episode/trace-family before dataset freeze; therefore the one-shot Together job must remain NOT_CONSUMED / NOT_STARTED while this conflict is unresolved.
